sources.label: Wikipedia, "CoRoT-7b"
sources.quote: CoRoT-7b is an exoplanet orbiting the star CoRoT-7 in the constellation of Monoceros, 520 light-years from the Earth.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around CoRoT-7. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "CoRoT-7b"
sources.quote: It was first detected photometrically by the French-led CoRoT mission and reported in February 2009.
